Title: Persona 4
Dialogues: ["Oho ...  You're cute. You're the student who started working here today, right?", "I'll show you something fun the next time you're here.", "I'll see you again.", "Oh, it's you, the student worker. I see you're doing your job.", "I'm sorry. I haven't introduced myself.", "I'm Sayoko Uehara. Nice to meet you.", "When you're done here, come on by the nurse's station. I'll pour you some hot coffee.", ' ...  ... ', ' ... Just kidding.', "I hear you're a high schooler ... ", 'Hmhm, your skin is so smooth ... ', "Hey ...  You know what I'm getting at, don't you?", "Don't worry, no one'll see ... ", ' ...  ... ', 'Oho ...  How adorable!', ' ... I like you.', "When's the next time you're coming? I'll adjust my shift.", 'Looks like even a town like this has something fun to do ... ', "I'll see you again.", 'Oh, you sweet thing. Well, then ... ', "Would you like to study with me? Perhaps a subject they don't teach in school, if you catch my drift ... ?", "Oho ...  You're an honest guy. That's cute, in boys your age.", "I don't find your type around here.", 'The kids over here are much simpler. All they see is the carrot dangling in front of their faces ... ', "You're ...  I know. You seem to have some sort of secret deep inside you ... ", " ... I think it's irresistible.", "I'll see you again.", 'Well done.', "You could just slack off and do a half-assed job, but you really do work your cute little butt off, don't you?", ' ... So why are you working at a job like this?', "Hmmmm. You're a starving student?", 'Then should you really be caught up here with a "naughty" lady like me?', "But still, a young child shouldn't be wasting time wiping windows at the hospital ... ", "I'm sure there are girls who would cry if they saw you doing menial chores like this.", 'Speaking of which ...  Say, do you have a girlfriend?', "Oho ...  Then you can't let your girlfriend see you like this, hmm?", ' ... High schoolers are so young.', "They're only ten years younger, but they seem so far away ... ", "It's like they're glittering. I feel this ...  What do you call it? Envy?", "Maybe that's why ... ", ' ...  ... ', ' ... I just want to see them get screwed over by life.', 'Oho, that was a joke, of course.', 'Half of it was, anyway ... ', " ... Do you see what I'm getting at?", "Oho ...  I keep telling you, silly, that that's the kind of reaction I just find ...  irresistible ... !", 'I have to go now. I have a lot of work piling up.', "But I just can't help myself ... ", "It's because you're just so cute ... ", "Sorry to bother you while you're on the job. Keep up the good work, okay?", 'That room over there needs some work done in it. Perhaps you could ... ?', ' ... Oh, whatever, just get in there.', 'The patient who had been in this room left just a little while ago. I want you to mop the floor.', " ... Don't ask what happened here.", 'Oho, I was just kidding.', 'The patient who was here was released today. He returned right from the brink of death!', 'He was a good patient, who always listened to what I said.', "Plus, he was the president of his company at a young age. He was handsome, didn't complain, and independent.", 'He wanted to get back to his work ...  Desperately.', 'And, thanks to his perseverance, he was able to leave even earlier than we had scheduled to release him.', '"Thank you for caring for me," he said, bowing to me so happily ... ', 'Then he turned and walked out.', 'He said such stupid things, like that he loved me.', ' ... Everyone leaves.', "They only need me when they're my patients ...  In the end, they all leave me.", 'You make it sound easy ... ', "Well, I guess that's to be expected. You're still a high school student ...  and it's not like you know me.", ' ... I must not have been making sense. Forget about what I was saying.', "I'll ask another janitor to handle this room. You go on home.", "The streets are dark ...  You shouldn't be here.", "You wouldn't want to get caught ...  by me.", 'Nice work.', ' ... Did you hear that commotion?', 'That was the first time anyone ever called me a "slutty bitch" to my face ... ', 'Seriously.', "When I laughed at her feeble attempt at an insult, she scratched at me. Who's the bitch now ... ?", 'At the previous hospital I worked at ...  I had a relationship with one of the doctors.', 'But ...  he had a wife.', 'She found out, I was forced to quit ...  and I started working here.', 'Not too long after, it seems he began flirting again, this time with a different nurse at the hospital.', "I don't know what happened, but I got dragged back into it. His wife came all the way here to bitch at me.", '(sigh) The other nurses were just watching, with these stupid smirks on their faces.', "Haha ...  You're right. I'd probably do the same, in their place ... ", 'Strangers are strangers ... ', "(sigh) Everything's just a pain.", "It wasn't like this at first ...  when I first thought about becoming a nurse.", 'What am I working for ... ?', 'What am I living for ... ?', "Oh ...  I'm sorry, I was just grumbling to myself.", "You're pretty bold, for a kid.", "I'd better go. I'm sure that bitch is gone by now.", 'Be careful going home.', " ... Stop it. Do you think you're some kind of counselor now?", "I'm sorry ... ", "There's no point in taking it out on you ... ", 'I just got a call from the hospital I last worked at.', 'The patient I was assigned to ...  died.', 'He was still just a little child ... ', "He always said he wanted to go to school ...  But it looks like he'll never get that chance ... ", "You know, he proposed to me ...  I told him I'd think about it when he became an adult.", 'But I ...  I forgot about him!', 'When I transferred here, I was so busy. I thought about him once in a while, but soon I just forgot ... ', 'But he was fighting for his life that entire time!', 'What am I doing ... ?', 'I do ...  Of course I blame myself ... ', 'Why did I transfer ... ?', "When a patient gets better, I get left behind ...  But, now I'm the one who left a patient behind ... ", "There should've been something I could have done ... ", "Oh, I'm sorry ... ", " ... I'm glad you came today.", " ... I'll do it. There has to be something ...  anything I can do.", 'Goodbye.', 'If you have time to chat, you have time to go check on all the patients.', 'Nakata-san, Room 512! Did you finish disimpacting the patient?', "I see you're skilled at slacking off.", "Takahashi-san, the equipment order form wasn't filled out properly. In several places.", "I've already fixed it and sent it in!", 'Just go.', "Souji-kun ...  I see you're working. That's good.", "I'll be going, then ... ", 'Right, I can still work.', 'Yep ...  Very nice and clean.', "I like you because you don't slack off.", " ... Oh, I don't have time to hang around here, either. It's going to be another all-nighter for me ... ", ' ... Goodbye.', "I'm fine.", " ... I have work to do. If you'll excuse me.", "Don't tell me you're slacking off, too ... ", "I know I'm getting nowhere ... ", 'But I have to do it ... ', 'Goodbye, now.', 'I was just a little wobbly ... ', "They're trying to get rid of me. I'm always pressuring them to do their jobs.", "(sigh) I'm lucky they didn't tie me down with an IV. I'm all right now ... ", "I'll be going.", 'Wh-What? Why are you acting so high and mighty ... ?', ' ...  ... ', 'I mean ... ', "I might be able to save someone's life.", "I need to do what I can. I can't spend time worrying about myself.", "Otherwise ...  I'd never be able to face him again ... ", 'O-Of course he would ... ', "Wouldn't he ... ?", ' ...  ... ', 'Oh ...  I see. I ... ', 'I was doing it for myself ... ', 'I wanted to escape the pain ... ', 'I was working hard, to avoid feeling anything at all ... ', 'I see that now ... ', "Haha ...  I'm so stupid.", 'I get it ...  Yeah, I get it ... ', 'Thank you ... ', " ... I'm going to rest for a little while longer. You can go now.", "Don't look at me ... ", "I'm sorry. You're already done with work today, aren't you?", 'I wanted to say goodbye.', " ... I'm leaving this hospital today.", 'I grew to hate hospitals ... ', 'All the life and death ...  In the end everyone leaves, leaving me behind.', 'I was lonely ... ', 'Then I remembered.', "I remembered that ...  I wanted to help. I became a nurse because I wanted to save people's lives.", "I couldn't see that it was as simple as that ... ", "No ...  I probably didn't want to see it.", 'And to think that the one who would show me this is just some kind with a rag in his hand.', ' ... I tend to go for older rich men, and I landed a child.', "So ...  I'm going.", "I'm going to be my own guide. Thinking, walking, taking responsibility for myself ... ", "Once I've done all that, I think I can finally say that I've truly lived.", ' ...  ... ', 'Will you take this?', 'I give you the person I was when I was here.', "I'm going to say this. It's as much to myself as it is to you.", "What's right ...  What you should choose to do in life ...  The answers to those things lie within you.", 'Now ...  So long.', "What's right ...  What you should choose to do in life ...  The answers to those things lie within you.", "Life ...  It's filled with so many things that are dirty, grotesque, and painful ... ", "There's no way you can stand it alone ... ", "But no one is truly alone in this world. You know that, since you've protected those precious to you, right?", "C'mon, people are waiting for you ... "]

Title: Persona 4
Dialogues: ['How dare you stand against me for being a rotten orange!', "I'll make a worthless human like you taste endless pain!", 'Take this!', 'You seemed to have slept well last night.', 'You slept so well that not even the noisy siren from the police cars woke you.', 'I think something really bad happened ... ', 'Can you go buy some coffee from the café at the arcade? Thanks.', 'Did you hear a girl was killed?', "It's becoming a dangerous world out there ...  I don't even feel safe walking around town ... ", "Don't let your guard down, and make sure you're not out late, okay?", 'Did you sleep well I heard that a girl was killed last night.', 'The noise of the arcade was bad, but can you buy some coffee from the café in the police cars?', "Thanks, I can't even safely walk around ...  I can safely withdraw cash now.", "Have you heard? Good morning. Don't be out dangerously late, okay?", "Relax and don't let your guard down.", 'How dare you stand against me for being a rotten orange!', "You're ... ", "Yyyyooouuuuu'''rrrreeeee ... ", ' ...  ... ', ' ...  ... ', 'Because ...  I feel nothing ... ', 'And you ...  are me ... ', ' ...  ... ', "So you don't accept me ... ", "Come ...  I'll end your emptiness.", 'Come ... ', "There's no need to be scared. It'll be quick.", "In this phase, Shadow Mitsuo will start by using Stagnant Air to greatly increase the chances of you being hit by status effects. He will then start using Evil Touch on people to fear them, and if anyone is feared at the start of his turn he'll use Ghastly Wail to instantly kill them. After a bit he'll use the skill Whisper to start regenerating Mitsuo the Hero.", "Why ... ? Don't you want to be at ease?", "If we can do enough damage to him before he regenerates the shell fully, it'll break and he'll be Downed, giving us another All-Out Attack. At that point he'll focus entirely on regenerating his shell, which is pretty much impossible to stop. He'll use Chant and then Prayer, at which point Mitsuo the Hero is back.", "That ominous message tells us that Mitsuo the Hero is stronger now, which he is indeed. He does more damage with his Attack and Bomb, and now he can use his Spell, Gigadyne. Gigadyne does large amounts of Almighty damage to the party, and he'll use it for sure as his first action. Once again you want to burn Mitsuo the Hero down as fast as possible while keeping Exhaust off of people. Once it dies, Shadow Mitsuo returns. It works exactly the same way, with another random element chosen at the start. You want to go at Shadow Mitsuo as hard as possible now to ensure he dies before he can regenerate his shell again, because Mitsuo the Hero is very powerful if he gets to return again.", "The party I used for this is Chie, Yukiko, and Teddie. Teddie gives us the ability to cure Exhaust and both he and Yukiko are brutally powerful on this boss. The last slot is actually sort of a toss-up because Yosuke, Chie, and Kanji are all pretty similar on this boss. I'd suggest not using Yosuke because he has the same weakness as Teddie personally. I'd also suggest you get to about level 43 so that Yukiko gets Mediarama and Teddie Matarukaja. Black Frost is incredible on this fight but really any decent Persona will do, just watch for his magical attacks in the Shadow phase because if he gets a Megidola off you're likely to lose."]

Title: Persona 4
Dialogues: ['Good evening, everyone. I am the Detective Prince, Naoto Shirogane.', 'I will be experimentor and experimentee both in a forbidden yet wonderful bodily alteration process!', 'You shall witness my departure into a new realm ...  The moment of a new birth!', 'From the chosen day forth, I shall walk a completely different path in life ... !', 'And I will share this glorious occasion, this memorable day, with all of you!', 'Do stay tuned!', "No! No, no, don't go!", "Why? Why're you leaving me here!? Why am I always left alone!?", "It's so lonely ...  I don't wanna be alone!", "These childish gestures are no mere affectation ...  They're the truth.", 'The fools all say it, don\'t they ... ? "You\'re only a child," "Keep out of our business, kid," and so forth.', "No matter how many cases you spend hours cogitating over, no matter how many crimes you solve, you're a child in their eyes.", "It's your brain they're interested in. The grey matter locked up in that skull.", "As long as they need it, you're an ace detective! But once you're done, it's back to the playpen with you.", "You haven't the means to deal with society's two-faced nature ... ", "You're just a lonely child.", 'I wanna be a grown-up ... ', "I wanna be a big boy right now ...  Then they'll see who I am ... ", 'I ...  I want a reason for me to stay ... ', "Hah ...  I'm telling you that's impossible.", 'You are but a child. How can you change that essential truth?', 'At your core, you admire the sort of "strong" and "cool" men who populate detective fiction.', "But in trying to emulate them, you must know that in truth, you're nothing of the sort-you're a child.", "There's no avoiding first principles ...  Admit that you're a child, and admit that there's nothing you can do about it.", 'Now then! Our analysis is complete. Let us begin the body alteration procedure.', 'You have no objections, do you ...  "Naoto" Shirogane?', '"Naoto" ...  Such a cool, manly name!', "But a name doesn't change the truth. It doesn't let you cross the barrier between the sexes.", "(chuckle) Hahahaha! How often I've heard those words from the adults.", '"Throwing a tantrum won\'t solve anything, Naoto-kun," and other such bilge!', "They made you cry, didn't they?", 'Yet here you are, mimicking those same men. What exactly are you trying to justify?', "It's all right. You needn't suffer anymore. Title: Persona 4
Dialogues: ['Ever had one of those days? You know, the kind where you wonder what you did to someone in a past life? This was one of them, and it started even before I woke up. I had this weird-ass dream.', "I don't know what a blue limo driving through fog lined in blue velvet is supposed to mean, but I bet some shrink would get a damn paper out of coming up with something. Especially when I got to the people in there with me.", "Normally I don't really remember dreams, but this one is clear as a bell.", 'I wonder why I needed to tell my own creepy dream my name?', "I'm moving a million miles away from home, I don't need a creepy dream troll to tell me catastrophe is coming. The next part, though, was a little more odd.", "There's been some story or another all over the news about some politician, Namatame or something, who's been stepping out on his wife with that news announcer Yamano. Nothing really interesting. Anyway my uncle had sent me a message saying he'd meet me at the station when I arrived.", 'I started kind of fuzzing out, seeing some strange things on the train. Luckily it got to Inaba before I started hallucinating or something.', "I wasn't left waiting long.", "I hadn't seen my uncle in like forever.", "I'd not met my cousin Nanako at all, he's got some crazy job that takes up all his time and stops him coming to visit.", 'It was a bit of a drive back into town, and we ended up stopping for gas.', 'The attendant struck up a conversation with me.', ' Nanako is looking at you.', 'I started feeling kind of queasy. I guess it was the trip.', 'Dojima got back from his smoke, and we finished our drive.', 'We sat down and had some dinner.', 'If I was going to be stuck here, at least it would be with nice people.', 'Before we could start, Dojima got a call.', 'Dojima left, and Nanako turned the TV on.', 'Crap, not this again. Why do people get so obsessed with these things?', "Those things have been sprouting up like mushrooms all over the place. But out here, I guess it's your best bet for shopping. Nanako seems to like the place.", "I'm pretty bushed. Time to get to sleep.", "At least things can't get any weirder.", 'The ancient Chinese had a curse: "May you live in interesting times." I think I\'m starting to get that now. Where do I start? Had an even more bullshit dream last night.', 'Everything was shrouded in fog, which might have been a good thing because the floor looked really unsettling for whatever reason.', ' This is…?', 'As I moved forward, I heard a voice. It was just as indistinct as the world around me.', 'There was some kind of door at the end of the path. I had a bad feeling about it.', "The other room was filled with even thicker fog. I hadn't even realized I was carrying it before, but I found a sword in my hands. It felt pretty natural, even though I've not really used one before.", 'There was someone else in there with me.', 'I could just barely make out where the voice was coming from.', 'And I lost track of the voice.', 'The fog was replaced by darkness.', ' What could it have been about…?', "Anyway, I didn't have time to think about some crazy fog dream because it was time for school soon.", "I noticed Dojima wasn't around.", ' You decided to head to school with Nanako.', "It was raining pretty heavily. The school zone is in the Samegawa river's flood plain.", 'I was almost at school when some lunatic nearly killed himself on his bike.', 'Had to hurt.', ' What kind of student life awaits you here…?', "I already don't like this teacher.", "What the hell is this guy's problem?", 'I got a nice save just about then.', "It seems this guy's a notorious asshole.", ' Your life at this new school has begun.', ' Will you be able to fit in here…?', 'In an orderly and just world this would have been the worst thing that happened today.', 'And the prick left, just in time for the sirens to start. Everyone started to freak out.', 'Then there was another announcement, seemed we could go now.', 'The girl sitting next to me came up to me before I could leave.', 'Before we could leave, the guy who wiped out on his bike earlier came up to us. Seemed he had something to talk to Chie about.', "Note to self: Chie's kicks are brutally accurate.", "I sure as hell wasn't going to get kicked myself. And things just kept getting stranger and stranger.", 'Creepy fisheye bastard ran off.', 'Dude just cannot win.', "I explained to them how I'd ended up here in Inaba.", 'It was sort of out of nowhere, and I panicked.', 'The discussion was saved from going downhill by the worst possible circumstances.', 'And of course Dojima was there.', 'One thing was sure, I did not want to be mistaken for one of these ghouls wanting to see a dead body.', 'It must have been a real mess, because this one cop came barreling out and threw up all over the place.', ' The two of them left.', 'Nanako was alone in the house when I got there. The news explained exactly why.', ' The School Zone is being shown on TV.', ' Could this be the incident you heard about…?', 'It was a real bombshell.', 'She seemed really upset.', " Her affair with a local councilman's secretary had been on the news just the other day.", 'Fortunately, the commercials started just then.', 'I decided to join the spirit of the thing.', ' Nanako sings the song to herself over and over again.', " It seems that she's forgotten all about the scary story.", "Who the hell does that? Who hangs a body from a TV antenna? And how does that even work? How do you get a body all the way up there? I know it's none of my business, but… I have to admit, this all feels important.", "Already I'm getting used to this crazy place. I ran into that guy who sits near me in class. Well, more like he almost ran into me. Again.", 'Man took a serious tumble. And yet he keeps on ticking.', 'Had a good point too.', "It's a good thing we were running late and there was nobody to see us ride in, because that's a visual that could really stick with you. At least we got in before Morooka.", 'Anyway, after school Yosuke wanted to thank me for pulling him out of that can.', "I don't even know where Chie was, she materialized out of nowhere.", "Yosuke wasn't happy about having to treat Chie as well, but he wasn't going to risk another kick. Where he took us was kind of sketchy, though.", 'I mean Junes. Come on.', 'We talked for a bit, and eventually the conversation moved to Junes.', "He was talking about some girl who'd just walked in.", 'Saki and Yosuke walked over.', "Man's been kicked in the balls enough literally lately, I decided to go easy on him.", 'Chie had a crazy suggestion.', 'Yosuke decided to change the subject from crazy rumors.', " You heard the rumor about the Midnight Channel, where one can see one's soulmate on a rainy night.", "The Midnight Channel, huh…? Anyway, Dojima still wasn't home when I got back.", 'And sure enough, he was.', " Could the incident be tied to their lover's quarrel…?", 'Still, how would that politician dude have put her body up on an antenna? It makes no sense. Anyway, they had an interview with the person who found the body next. They seemed oddly familiar.', " The female student's face and voice are indistinct.", " The reporter's enthusiasm seems to be perplexing the girl.", 'Wait, could it be…?', "I mean how could it be an accident? Then again, how could it be anything? Things like this don't happen.", "Nanako said she could handle getting her father to bed, so I excused myself. I'm sure this Midnight Channel thing is nonsense, but I don't want to get kicked so I'd better humor Chie.", ' You made a promise to try out the rumor about the Midnight Channel.', ' Return to your room and watch the Midnight Channel?', 'What the fuck? Did that just happen?', " Could Chie's story be true…?", 'Midnight came closer and closer.', 'And the TV came to life!', 'The image came more into focus. There was a girl there!', '"I am thou. Thou art I. Thou art the one who opens the door." What the hell?', 'My hand went right through!', "I was almost sucked in, I'm just glad my TV's so damn small.", 'I managed to pull back out of the TV, and landed with a hard thud.', 'I had to think fast.', ' Nanako seems to have returned to her room.', ' What just happened…?', ' You decide to talk about it with the others tomorrow.', "If there weren't two other people who would swear today happened just the way I'm writing now I'd assume I was totally fucked in the head. Normally when your day starts with a teacher in an Egyptian headdress that's the weirdest thing that happens in that day.", 'Too easy.', "Everyone was still talking about the murder. Can't say I blame them. Yosuke was freaking too.", 'Chie was excited about the rumors going around.', "I decided to tell them about last night's little fiasco. I mean, if they'd seen the Midnight Channel maybe all the other stuff hit them too.", "Chie took a break from mocking me when she reminded herself of something. I'd say something but for the whole lightning reflexes and brutal accuracy thing.", ' You decided to go to Junes with the others.', 'I was sure I was never going to live that story down.', 'They walked away to the smaller TVs nearby, while I kept just looking at this one. Something was bothering me about it.', 'Just to prove to myself it was all a dream, I reached out to touch the screen.', 'And went straight through it.', 'Yosuke picked that moment to turn around and ask me about something.', "They ran over to see what was up. For my part, I wasn't sure whether I was happy or sad to be proven right.", 'This was one of those things that seemed like a good idea at the time.', ' You tell them that.', 'Oh, Yosuke.', "And then they panicked, and we learned that as long as I'm stuck in the TV anyone can fall in. Who knew?", 'It felt like we were going to fall forever.', 'But eventually you always hit bottom.', 'The damn place was a sea of fog.', 'Everything was sort of strange and staticky, too.', 'I was feeling okay, but I wanted to make sure the others were fine.', 'If we looked closely, we could see our surroundings through the fog.', 'What we needed was a damn way out.', "Yosuke's sense of direction is infallible, by the way. You know, if you're wanting to become even more lost.", 'We ended up in some creepy room. Looked sort of like a hotel room or something. You know, in hell.', 'I had to agree with Chie here.', 'And it just got worse and worse.', 'The fog in there is terrible.', " Could it be due to this place's oppressive atmosphere…?", 'And when we got back to the studio section, things managed to get even stranger.', 'Something was indeed there.', "I don't know how to explain this. It was some kind of bear… thing.", 'And it could talk.', "I figured we'd catch more bears with honey or something.", 'Chie was really not taking anything from the bear thing.', 'By the way note to self: Honey attracts bears.', 'The bear did some weird tapping thing and boom, TVs out of nowhere.', 'Yosuke noticed something chilling.', 'We stuck together as long as we could. The chill we felt had nothing to do with the rain.', "I remembered Yosuke said he'd not seen her in school earlier.", 'And then the news started. More on that damn murder case.', 'Then things started to get kind of creepy in a new way honestly.', ' The news continues.', 'What the hell is going on?', ' You sneezed.', 'I knew something must be up right from the moment I got up, Dojima was rushing out.', 'Gossip was already starting even before people knew what was up.', ' …You decide to head to school.', 'They called us all in for an assembly.', ' You overhear people gossiping about something.', 'It was worse than we ever could have imagined.', "Old bastard's only concerned with covering his own ass. And nobody could stop talking about the damn details of her death.", 'People can be so ghoulish.', 'It was about that point I figured out where Yosuke was going with this, and a chill ran down my spine.', "At first I'd thought Yosuke was grasping at straws out of grief, but there was some definite sense to it.", 'He was right, though, if it was true that the death had something to do with the other world, the police were going to be useless.', 'I was inclined to help him out, but I did want a second opinion.', "We headed to Junes. Yosuke had made some 'preparations' in the mean time.", "I knew I couldn't, but Chie… I don't want to see someone else put in danger here.", ' You voiced your concern over Chie coming along.', "Yosuke handed me a golf club and some bandages and ointment he'd picked up.", 'Once again we had a hard fall, and once again we encountered that bear.', 'What do you say when a bear is calling you a killer?', 'I had to agree.', 'That was when we noticed the line had broken as we entered.', 'How the hell were we supposed to prove that?', 'The bear was firmly convinced we were the killers.', 'None of this made any damn sense.', 'What the hell…?', 'He had a very effective threat.', 'Now it all made sense. That damn dream.', ' Could this be the mystery that will be thrust upon you…?', ' What was the "contract" Igor spoke of…?', ' Could finding the culprit and solving the case be part of this promise…?', "Fate, destiny, whatever you call it. I didn't really buy into that shit before, but this was an awful coincidence.", 'Should have seen this coming.', 'We put on the glasses, and the difference was amazing!', ' Can Teddie really not fight…?', 'I decided to test that out.', "Yeah, he can't fight.", "Teddie led us through the TV world to our destination, a horrible parody of Inaba's shopping district.", "I'm not entirely sure what half the stuff Teddie says is supposed to mean.", 'Yosuke ran off, and Teddie and I followed. He stopped at a liquor store with a strange red light pouring from the door.', 'And with that, the nightmare began.', 'Teddie had talked about Shadows being the other things that lived here, and now we knew what he meant. At first they looked just like blobs of darkness, but they quickly changed into even more freakish shapes.', 'As the Shadows approached, I once again heard that strange voice from before!', 'For just an instant a shadowy figure loomed behind me, but whatever it was, I was sure it was on my side.', 'This seemed to enrage the Shadows, and they attacked.', "Combat in Persona 4 is pretty simple. Character speeds set the turn order. The basic character options are to Attack with their equipped weapon, to Guard to reduce damage from the next hit they take, to use an Item, or to use a Skill from their Persona. The main character also has the ability to set Tactics in battle and change Personas, though those won't matter until we have a party and more Personas. Shadows in turn can also use a basic Attack, Guard, or a Skill. We can get an extra action in combat by knocking Down an enemy. This happens if we land a critical hit with a physical attack or strike a weakness of theirs. The same thing happens if the enemy strikes one of our weaknesses, though. These Slipping Hableries are weak against Lightning, so we're able to easily dispatch them. Once we've tried some attacks out on a target, we can Analyze them. This lets us see a record of what we've demonstrated to be the strengths and weaknesses of an enemy. That's all we really need to know about combat.", 'With this newfound strength, I managed to defeat the Shadows.', "I'm not sure what it's supposed to mean, but my Persona took the form of Izanagi. He's the god who's supposed to have created Japan in ancient times.", "Yosuke was pretty freaked, and I can't really say as I blame him. At this point two Yosukes wasn't really anything exceptionally strange. Man my life is really messed up now.", 'The other Yosuke was a real prick, just to put that out there.', 'It turned out telling it that was a big mistake.', 'The double had absorbed hundreds of Shadows into itself, and became some kind of freakish frog thing.', "Shadow Yosuke is here to teach us about Guarding, one of the major new features in Persona 4. Shadow Yosuke is weak against our Zio skill but has a skill, Wind of Oblivion, that hits our weakness to wind. He's quite predictable luckily.
